title: Chinese 'gold bar' cryptograms, Shanghai 1933 (McCurley, IACR 1996)

steps.what: Letter counts, IC 0.035, chi-squared against uniform 1.251 with Monte Carlo null.
Schmeh Top 50 and Pelling: anachronisms (Boeing 247, simplified characters, 1948) date the bars after 1933.
Transcription checked against the fifteen IACR photographs.

outcome.notes: Two independent lines (statistics, object dating) agree.

prior.where: Pelling and Bret Bowen noted the flat distribution; Schmeh/Pelling documentary case against the 1933 date

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
